get_ipv4_indicator.title: Look up IPv4 address
get_ipv4_indicator.description: Get OTX threat intelligence for IPv4 address. `section` picks the slice: general (pulses and summary), reputation, geo (location and ASN), malware (samples seen contacting it), url_list (URLs hosted on it), passive_dns (domains that resolved to it). Use `general` first; it lists the pulses that reference the indicator and which other sections hold data.

ip.description: The IPv4 address to look up.

section.description: Which part of the indicator's data to return.

output.description: The requested section of data for the IPv4 address.

get_ipv6_indicator.title: Look up IPv6 address
get_ipv6_indicator.description: Get OTX threat intelligence for IPv6 address. `section` picks the slice: general, reputation, geo, malware, url_list or passive_dns. Use `general` first; it lists the pulses that reference the indicator and which other sections hold data.

ip.description: The IPv6 address to look up.

section.description: Which part of the indicator's data to return.

output.description: The requested section of data for the IPv6 address.

get_domain_indicator.title: Look up domain
get_domain_indicator.description: Get OTX threat intelligence for domain. `section` picks the slice: general, geo, malware (samples that contacted it), url_list or passive_dns (addresses it resolved to). Use `general` first; it lists the pulses that reference the indicator and which other sections hold data.

section.description: Which part of the indicator's data to return.

output.description: The requested section of data for the domain.

get_hostname_indicator.title: Look up hostname
get_hostname_indicator.description: Get OTX threat intelligence for hostname. `section` picks the slice: general, geo, malware, url_list or passive_dns. Use `general` first; it lists the pulses that reference the indicator and which other sections hold data.

section.description: Which part of the indicator's data to return.

output.description: The requested section of data for the hostname.

get_file_indicator.title: Look up file hash (MD5, SHA1 or SHA256)
get_file_indicator.description: Get OTX threat intelligence for file hash (MD5, SHA1 or SHA256). `section` picks the slice: general (pulses and metadata) or analysis (static and sandbox results). Use `general` first; it lists the pulses that reference the indicator and which other sections hold data.

file_hash.description: The file hash (MD5, SHA1 or SHA256) to look up.

section.description: Which part of the indicator's data to return.

output.description: The requested section of data for the file hash (MD5, SHA1 or SHA256).

get_url_indicator.title: Look up URL
get_url_indicator.description: Get OTX threat intelligence for URL. `section` picks the slice: general (pulses and summary) or url_list (scan results and server details). Use `general` first; it lists the pulses that reference the indicator and which other sections hold data.

section.description: Which part of the indicator's data to return.

output.description: The requested section of data for the URL.

get_cve_indicator.title: Look up CVE id
get_cve_indicator.description: Get OTX threat intelligence for CVE id. `section` picks the slice: general (description, CVSS, references and related pulses). Use `general` first; it lists the pulses that reference the indicator and which other sections hold data.

cve.description: The CVE id to look up.

section.description: Which part of the indicator's data to return.

output.description: The requested section of data for the CVE id.

get_nids_indicator.title: Look up NIDS rule id
get_nids_indicator.description: Get OTX threat intelligence for NIDS rule id. `section` picks the slice: general (the rule and the pulses that reference it). Use `general` first; it lists the pulses that reference the indicator and which other sections hold data.

nids.description: The NIDS rule id to look up.

section.description: Which part of the indicator's data to return.

output.description: The requested section of data for the NIDS rule id.

get_correlation_rule_indicator.title: Look up correlation rule id
get_correlation_rule_indicator.description: Get OTX threat intelligence for correlation rule id. `section` picks the slice: general (the rule and the pulses that reference it). Use `general` first; it lists the pulses that reference the indicator and which other sections hold data.

correlation_rule.description: The correlation rule id to look up.

section.description: Which part of the indicator's data to return.

output.description: The requested section of data for the correlation rule id.

submit_url.title: Submit a URL for analysis
submit_url.description: Submit one suspicious URL for OTX to visit and analyse; files it serves are analysed too. Check progress with list_submitted_urls and read results with get_url_indicator. Use submit_urls for several at once.

submit_urls.title: Submit URLs for analysis
submit_urls.description: Submit several suspicious URLs at once for OTX to visit and analyse. Check progress with list_submitted_urls.

list_submitted_urls.title: List submitted URLs
list_submitted_urls.description: List the URLs you have submitted for analysis with each one's status and dates. Completed results are read with get_url_indicator.

sort.description: Order by add_date, url or complete_date.

list_submitted_files.title: List submitted files
list_submitted_files.description: List the files you have submitted for analysis with each one's status. Completed results are read with get_file_indicator using the file's hash.

sort.description: Order by add_date, sha256 or complete_date.

update_submitted_urls_tlp.title: Change submitted URLs' TLP
update_submitted_urls_tlp.description: Change the TLP sharing level of URLs you submitted yourself. It cannot be changed when someone else submitted the same URL.

update_submitted_files_tlp.title: Change submitted files' TLP
update_submitted_files_tlp.description: Change the TLP sharing level of files you submitted yourself, identified by hash. It cannot be changed when someone else submitted the same file.

hashes.description: Hashes of the submitted files to update.

get_pulse.title: Get a pulse
get_pulse.description: Fetch one pulse: its name, description, author, tags, TLP, targeted countries and industries, malware families, ATT&CK ids and indicators.

pulse_id.description: The pulse id (24 hex characters), from a pulse list or search.

update_pulse.title: Edit a pulse
update_pulse.description: Edit a pulse you own. Send only what changes: plain fields such as name, description, public or TLP, and for list fields an object with add and remove lists, e.g. {"tags": {"add": ["apt"], "remove": ["old"]}, "indicators": {"add": [{"indicator": "8.8.8.8", "type": "IPv4"}]}}.

pulse_id.description: The pulse id (24 hex characters), from a pulse list or search.

changes.description: The fields to change, in the shape described above.

list_pulse_indicators.title: List a pulse's indicators
list_pulse_indicators.description: Page through the indicators of compromise in a pulse: each with its type, value, title, description and dates. Use this instead of get_pulse for pulses with many indicators.

pulse_id.description: The pulse id (24 hex characters), from a pulse list or search.

list_pulses_related_to_pulse.title: List pulses related to a pulse
list_pulses_related_to_pulse.description: List pulses that share indicators or context with the given pulse.

pulse_id.description: The pulse id (24 hex characters), from a pulse list or search.

find_related_pulses.title: Find related pulses
find_related_pulses.description: Find pulses related to exactly one of: a pulse id, a malware family or an adversary. Supply only one of the three.

pulse_id.description: Find pulses related to this pulse.

malware_family.description: Find pulses about this malware family.

list_subscribed_pulses.title: List subscribed pulses
list_subscribed_pulses.description: Page through the pulses in your OTX feed: those you subscribe to directly or through the users and groups you follow, each with its indicators. Pass modified_since to fetch only what changed since your last sync.

modified_since.description: Only pulses modified after this ISO 8601 UTC time, e.g. 2024-01-01T12:35:00+00:00.

output.description: A page of pulses with indicators.

list_subscribed_pulse_ids.title: List subscribed pulse ids
list_subscribed_pulse_ids.description: List only the ids of the pulses you are subscribed to, a much lighter call than list_subscribed_pulses.

list_pulse_activity.title: List recent pulse activity
list_pulse_activity.description: Page through recently created or updated pulses across OTX, the public activity feed, optionally only those modified after a given time.

modified_since.description: Only pulses modified after this ISO 8601 UTC time, e.g. 2024-01-01T12:35:00+00:00.

list_pulse_events.title: List subscription events
list_pulse_events.description: List events on your subscribed pulses (created, updated, deleted, subscribed, unsubscribed) since a given time, for keeping a local copy of your feed in sync, including removals.

modified_since.description: Only pulses modified after this ISO 8601 UTC time, e.g. 2024-01-01T12:35:00+00:00.

list_user_pulses.title: List a user's pulses
list_user_pulses.description: List the public pulses created by an OTX user, optionally only those modified after a given time.

since.description: Only pulses modified after this ISO 8601 UTC time, e.g. 2024-01-01T12:35:00+00:00.

output.description: A page of the user's pulses.

list_my_pulses.title: List my pulses
list_my_pulses.description: List the pulses you created, including private ones, optionally only those modified after a given time.

since.description: Only pulses modified after this ISO 8601 UTC time, e.g. 2024-01-01T12:35:00+00:00.

create_pulse.title: Create a pulse
create_pulse.description: Publish a new pulse: a named collection of indicators of compromise with context. `indicators` is a list of {indicator, type, title?, description?, role?}; valid types come from list_indicator_types. A public pulse is visible to all of OTX; set public false or name group_ids to restrict it.

public.description: true to publish to all of OTX, false to keep it private.

adversary.description: Threat actor the pulse is attributed to.

attack_ids.description: MITRE ATT&CK technique ids, e.g. T1059.

indicators.description: Indicators of compromise, each {indicator, type, title?, description?}.

group_ids.description: Ids of OTX groups to share the pulse with; you must be a member.

list_indicator_types.title: List indicator types
list_indicator_types.description: List the indicator types OTX accepts (IPv4, domain, hostname, URL, FileHash-SHA256, CVE, email and so on) with each type's slug, name and description. Use the names as `type` in create_pulse and validate_indicator.

validate_indicator.title: Validate an indicator
validate_indicator.description: Check that a value is a well-formed indicator of the given type before adding it to a pulse. Returns whether it is valid and, if not, why.

type.description: The indicator type, from list_indicator_types, e.g. IPv4.

search_pulses.title: Search pulses
search_pulses.description: Full-text search across OTX pulses by keyword, such as a malware name, CVE id or campaign. Sort by modified, created or subscriber_count.

sort.description: Order by modified, created or subscriber_count.

search_users.title: Search users
search_users.description: Search OTX users by name. Sort by username or pulse_count.

get_current_user.title: Get the current user
get_current_user.description: Read the OTX account behind the API key: username, user id, member-since date and counts of pulses, indicators, subscribers and followers. The cheapest call that proves the key works.
